name: editor
title: Editor
description: Markdown-backed rich text surface with optional static and floating format toolbars.

api.description: Markdown-backed rich text surface with optional static and floating format toolbars.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with serialized Markdown after edits settle.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Empty-state hint. Defaults to the kit string catalogue.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Blocks edits and hides interactive toolbar controls.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: CSS length applied to --df-editor-min-height for this instance.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: static pins a format bar above the surface. floating shows a selection toolbar. both enables both. none hides kit chrome.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the editable surface on mount.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the editable surface. Defaults to the kit string catalogue. Override when the host already names the field with a visible Label.

groups.title: Accessibility
groups.description: Editable name: The contenteditable surface uses aria-label (catalogue default, or your override). Format toolbars use catalogue labels for icon-only controls. Prefer a visible Label with htmlFor only when you wrap a separate form control; this surface is not a native input.
